decks.name: LeetCode #211 - Design Add and Search Words Data Structure
decks.description: Design a data structure that supports adding words and searching with wildcard dots that can match any letter

cards.question: Design Add and Search Words Data Structure: Design a data structure that supports adding new words and finding if a string matches any previously added string. Implement the WordDictionary class with methods: 1) WordDictionary() initializes the object, 2) void addWord(word) adds word to the data structure, 3) bool search(word) returns true if there is any string in the data structure that matches word. The search word may contain dots '.' where a dot can be matched with any letter.

solutions.name: Depth First Search (Trie)
solutions.explanation: Use a trie to store words efficiently. For search with wildcard dots, use DFS to explore all possible branches when encountering a dot. Regular characters follow the standard trie path.

solutions.timeDescription: Linear time for addWord where n is the length of the word. For search, O(n) in best case with no wildcards, but can be O(26^n) in worst case if all characters are wildcards
solutions.spaceDescription: Space for total number of trie nodes t, plus recursion stack depth n for DFS during wildcard search
solutions.exampleWalkthrough: Add 'bad', 'dad', 'mad'. Search 'pad': no match, return false. Search '.ad': DFS tries 'b','d','m' branches at position 0, finds 'bad','dad','mad', return true. Search 'b..': DFS at positions 1 and 2 explores all paths, finds 'bad', return true.
